M1.scope: Skeleton, boot, HLE BIOS, main RAM, input + DDR3 cart paths

M3.scope: GXFIFO → serialised multiplier → triangle setup → flat rasteriser → VRAM write-back → 3D layer composited by engine A; both 2D engines' fetches in bursts and the OAM scan pipelined so a line fits its period
M3.left: W-buffer depth, fog, edge marking, toon shading, alpha test, QUADS/QUAD_STRIP, span fill

M4.scope: Sixteen SPU channels (PCM8/PCM16/ADPCM, loops, pan, master volume, 48 kHz mix); AUXSPI save probe over an emulated EEPROM/FRAM/FLASH chip; MT-32-pi MIDI and its return mix; timers, IPC, maths, per-CPU IRQ banks, HALT, RTC and the three-device SPI bus
M4.left: SPU capture units, `.sav` persistence and erase, cart unlock sequence, FLASH above its 64 KB backed window

M5.scope: Microphone Off / R3 button / board ADC (LTC2308 at 48 kHz through the touchscreen's AUX channel) and the SPI touchscreen; slot-2 rumble pak (open-bus pattern, pad motors); the lid chord on `EXTKEYIN`

M6.scope: Cheat engine (Action Replay, 8 entries per clock) and the DS-native menu, profiles and the video/audio filter rows
